testsuite.name: io.github.stslex.workeeper.runtime.AppRuntimeReplacementTest

testcase.name: terminal compensation failure is surfaced on the outcome()
rollback mechanics failure is Fatal with exact compensation ref()
a preflight inline rollback invalidates one candidate then a fresh attempt publishes()
restore swap failure with successful rollback - RecoveredByRollback, never Completed()
different operation gets its OWN serialized result - never the other operation's()
post-commit recovery journals exact compensation before applying N and preserves P()
the inline rollback disposes candidate through one teardown before exact-ref swap()
candidate dispose close failure stops the ladder FATAL - no rollback rename()
restart-process record failure keeps Prepared and immutable undo()
A reaches Fatal while B is queued - B performs no validation, close, swap or publish()
orphaned candidate close failure after graphFactory throw - Fatal, ladder stopped()
a retry whose record persistently fails never runs committed terminal()
lease timeout rejects before journal claim even if the caller dies()
restart-process close throw - FailedAfterMutation, never rejected, no rename()
a clear that is queued but never runs cannot hang the machine()
simultaneous callers keep distinct owners refs and terminal callbacks()
a requested rollback retry commits as requested operation never compensation()
ladder recovery keeps exact owned undo through terminal resolution()
one-shot requested rollback record failure commits once without stale terminal()
the ladder rolls back onto THIS attempt's undo not the older active ref()
a partially constructed generation joins its jobs before closing the orphan database()
replace after Fatal returns Fatal - never a cleanup-safe rejection()
a generation-1 orphan close-throw is Fatal never retryable rejection()
a rejection whose terminal persistence fails keeps its owned undo()
terminal effects hold the transition mutex - a successor cannot interleave them()
cancelled caller deleting its temp path cannot strand the transaction - it commits()
restart failure is Fatal and keeps later replacement admission sealed()
unjoinable outgoing job after PONR - Fatal, the database is never closed()
ladder recovery whose owned undo vanished goes Fatal and never applies P()
Fatal rejects reads and admission loudly - the acquirer never parks forever()
staging failure rejects before anything - no validation, compensation runs()
attach BEFORE the zero observation blocks the transition until disposed()
restart-process PONR terminally rejects a replacement already queued behind it()
post-finalization arm failure retries restored database without compensation()
durable rollback commit is recorded while exact source remains finalizer-owned()
the immutable undo is created inside the transaction after validation()
unreleased lease aborts pre-PONR - rejection, admission reopens, retry works()
a requested rollback whose record persistently fails ends FATAL - every asset preserved()
restart-process policy keeps UI and worker admission closed until restart()
the immutable undo exists before its Prepared journal claim()
the inline rollback with missing exact ref rejects without substitution()
a committed restore keeps immutable new undo without overwriting the previous one()
graphFactory failure with clean orphan close - ladder recovers by rollback()
a missing rollback ref is rejected and a different active ref is never substituted()
file mutation alone never selects committed terminal durable phase is load-bearing()
staging happens in the SUBMISSION frame - before the host coroutine ever runs()
rollback operation commits - Completed is the requested-op truth()
a record failure leaves previous active undo byte-for-byte intact()
restart policy treats an ambiguous journal claim failure as PONR()
journal claim failure after quiesce is Fatal and seals replacement admission()
an unjoinable candidate stops inline rollback Fatal with zero later renames()
candidate jobs are joined before the candidate database closes()
a rollback whose exact source fails validation is rejected without swap()
committed handover advances the snackbar epoch - an abort never does()
aborted transition reopens ui admission for the outgoing id()
compensation record failure cannot erase Prepared exact rollback journal()
a restore record failure has no committed terminal before compensation is durable()
finalization pending after durable commit refuses candidate publication()
validation failure - rejection with compensation, nothing irreversible()
the inline rollback applies its exact ref and never another active ref()
late ui attach after the zero observation is REFUSED - the retired id never reopens()
inline scenario-1 rollback - the outer RESTORE reports RecoveredByRollback()
a restore submitted from inside a transaction is rejected, never deadlocked()
restore transfers source ownership and swaps the exact staged ref()
immutable undo creation failure rejects before journal close or swap()
reinitialize after Fatal returns Fatal and publishes nothing()
strict replacement clears the probe ViewModel and joins the DB job BEFORE close()
a refused journal claim seals runtime and preserves both undo assets()
worker suspended in the closed window binds to the NEW generation()
committed effects failure is SURFACED - never a silently clean commit()
restart-process caller cancellation cannot reopen committed old generation()
capacity rejection creates no undo journal close or swap and keeps generation serving()
an exact rollback applies A while unrelated active P survives()
outgoing close failure is FATAL - no rename, no republished generation()
restart-process swap failure - FailedAfterMutation, journal effects, assets preserved()
